basic_info.description:
New construction building with many amenities and added value such as GPS in-unit air filtration system and additional acoustical work to ensure a quiet and peaceful unit. GE appliances, which includes in-unit laundry and package concierge system in the lobby. Open air workout area on the roof overlooking the city. Free to use BBQ and seating areas with fire pits.

Designed to respond to the needs of the contemporary San Francisco lifestyle. This building delivers the latest innovations in quality and environmentally conscious design supported by enriching amenities. Situated in the center of one of the city's most culturally diverse and vibrant neighborhoods, the architecturally striking building is an urban oasis in every sense. Unit features A/C and an abundance of natural light.
